## Defects and retests

For each failure or blocker, include reproduction steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, redacted evidence/log reference, issue owner, fix commit, and physical-device retest result.

## Final review

- [ ] All critical cases passed.
- [ ] Blockers and critical/high-severity defects are resolved or explicitly risk-accepted by an authorized reviewer.
- [ ] Evidence is redacted and contains no secrets or unnecessary personal data.
- [ ] Failed cases were retested on the same or a documented equivalent physical device.
- [ ] Outstanding risks and blocked tests are documented.
- [ ] Separate Kabul pilot and production-readiness gates were reviewed independently.

- Overall result: **Not Run / Pass / Fail / Blocked**
- Reviewer:
- Decision date:
- Decision: **Go / No-Go**
- Rationale and accepted risks:

> Do not infer production approval from this record alone. Physical-device acceptance, pilot evidence, production infrastructure and HTTPS checks, migration safety, backup/restore recovery, security/privacy review, monitoring/incident response, and authorized human sign-off are separate requirements.
